messages.content: Read-only independent design question, give YOUR OWN proposal <=450 words, no tools/implementation. User wants a working city courtyard demo by day end with visible water/ice freezing/melting plus separate smoke/fire. Existing fixed-mass enthalpy solver ThermalField has transactional cells/contact/source; editor ThermalPreview max16cells holds accepted state outside ECS with edit rebuild, Pause, Stop reset and readonly diagnostics. Renderer extracts ECS into DrawItem plus parallel generation-safe entities then resolves submeshes/material sets. MaterialRegistry append/update PBR data, immutable per-frame copied GPU uniforms. SceneRenderer already copies transient lights and particles, no material override seam. Need simplest honest opt-in validated phase presentation and repeatable saved scene + editor/standalone demo. Constraints: never mutate authored components or shared registry material, no collision/flow/thickness claims from mass fraction, clearing Stop/invalid graphs must restore authored appearance, failed step may show visibly marked last accepted state, preserve original paths when no inputs. Propose API/layering/lifecycle and decisive pixel/sensitivity/negative tests. Favor small reusable transient renderer seam plus removable adapter over shader changes, and bounded memory/no stale entity retargeting. We own edits and verify independently.
